findings.summary: Manual smoke in the Play webview on Windows (OQ-ra-1): 'Abrir PDF' opens the default reader and 'Mostrar na pasta' opens Explorer with the file selected. Not run here: this unattended session has no Play webview, and the real explorer.exe launch is only covered by command-line tests with a fake spawn.
macOS smoke of 'open' / 'open -R' not run (no macOS machine). Per BR-ra-06 the message with the folder covers that case; the macOS and Linux command lines are verified only through a fake spawn.

generated_files.company_id is nullable (still ON DELETE CASCADE) instead of required. Reason: the portfolio PDF (carteira-{data}.pdf, Phase 2) belongs to no single company and must still be openable by id ('Evolução e carteira exportam e abrem pelo mesmo estado de entrega'). A later migration could not relax the column without an ALTER/table rebuild, which the plan forbids.

server/services/reportService.ts is outside this unit's allowed files, so the registration of the saved PDF in generated_files (and the { fileId, fileName, directory } answer) is not wired yet. The repository, routes and opener are ready; until the report-api unit wires it, no record exists for the open/reveal routes to find in the running app.

messages.text: reportService (not in this unit) must register every saved file: after saveFile() call createGeneratedFileRepository(prisma).insert({ companyId, kind, fileName, directory, createdAt: now() }) and answer { fileId: record.id, fileName, directory }. If the insert fails, delete the saved file and throw write_failed. kind values: diagnosis_pdf, evolution_pdf, portfolio_pdf, questionnaire_html (GENERATED_FILE_KINDS in server/repositories/generatedFileRepository.ts; stored as text, so a new kind needs no migration). companyId is nullable: pass null for the portfolio PDF. findLatestByCompany(companyId, kinds = REPORT_PDF_KINDS) gives 'último PDF salvo' for homeService.

IF-002 is live: POST /api/files/:fileId/open and /reveal answer 204 (body never read). Errors: 404 file_not_found (no record, id > 64 chars, file gone/not a regular file, record outside the app's Downloads folder or with a non-plain file name) and 500 open_failed with message 'Não foi possível abrir. O arquivo está em {pasta}.' and error.directory. Client: src/api/filesApi.ts exports openSavedFile(fileId) and revealSavedFile(fileId) (Promise<void>); on failure ApiError.code is 'open_failed' (details = { directory }, type OpenFailureDetails) or 'file_not_found'.

createApp gained the optional dependency systemOpener (default: createSystemOpener(), the real one); server/main.ts passes it explicitly. Any e2e/Playwright server bootstrap that clicks 'Abrir PDF' / 'Mostrar na pasta' must inject a fake SystemOpener (interface in server/files/systemOpener.ts) or it will launch the real reader/Explorer.

tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts (not in this unit) resetData() does not delete generated_files; rows with companyId null survive the company deleteMany. tests/api/fileRoutes.test.ts clears them itself in beforeEach; consider adding prisma.generatedFile.deleteMany() to resetData so reportRoutes/portfolio tests do not see leftovers.

Checks to run after integration: (1) pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts tests/api/fileRoutes.test.ts once reportService registers the file; (2) in the Play dev-link on Windows: open the company -> Relatórios -> Exportar PDF -> 'Abrir PDF' (reader opens) and 'Mostrar na pasta' (Explorer opens with the file selected) — OQ-ra-1; (3) the same on macOS when a machine exists. The prisma client was regenerated here (server/generated/prisma), so other worktrees need prisma generate (prepare-app --generate).

scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs (not in this unit's file list) passes with the new migration but does not seed generated_files; its DATA_TABLES list only has companies, diagnoses and preferences. Optional: seed one generated_files row so the update path proves the new table survives the synthetic companies rebuild.
